# What’s new with MARQ (Gen 3)?


October 13, 2026


### *MARQ (Gen 3) adds inReach technology, worldwide maps, address search, diving capabilities and enhanced hardware.*


Your[MARQ® (Gen 2)](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/luxury-smartwatches/?FILTER_USERPROFILE_MARQGEN2=true) watch has been a statement piece designed for your passions. Whether you’re an athlete, golfer, pilot, sea lover or adventurer, it’s been a premium tool built to support you while looking great on your wrist.


Now you’re wondering if it’s time to upgrade to MARQ (Gen 3). With a larger display, built-in speaker and microphone, integrated LED flashlight, worldwide mapping, address search and new[inReach® connectivity](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/outdoor-recreation/satellite-communicators/) , the latest MARQ collection adds capabilities that can make a real difference both on and off the grid.


Keep reading as we break down the biggest differences between MARQ (Gen 2) and MARQ (Gen 3).


## Refined design and new hardware


For adventurers in pursuit of excellence, the Garmin MARQ collection sets the standard for purpose-built luxury smartwatches forged from premium materials. MARQ (Gen 3) builds on that foundation with a refined design that’s slimmer, more durable and more comfortable to wear every day. Crafted to withstand the most rugged conditions with materials like titanium, ceramic, and sapphire, it looks just as good at dinner as it does on your next adventure.


Each MARQ model still includes details inspired by its intended pursuit, helping it feel unique while staying true to the collection’s high-end look and feel.


MARQ (Gen 3) also introduces several upgrades you’ll notice right away. A larger 1.4-inch AMOLED display makes information easier to read at a glance, while a built-in speaker and microphone add convenience throughout the day. There’s also an integrated LED flashlight with microlensing, giving you quick access to improved visibility when you need it most.


## Stay connected beyond cell coverage


For those who spend time exploring beyond the reach of traditional networks, MARQ (Gen 3) adds an extra layer of confidence and peace of mind with the addition of built-in inReach connectivity1.


With LTE connectivity enabled, users can stay connected while on the go by sending and receiving messages, making calls and sharing their location with friends and family through LiveTrack. When adventures extend beyond cellular coverage, built-in inReach technology provides access to two-way satellite messaging, location sharing and SOS services through[Garmin Response](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/satellite-communicators/interactive-sos-and-garmin-response/) ™, our 24/7-staffed emergency coordination center.


## Smarter navigation


MARQ (Gen 3) brings point-to-point navigation to your wrist with a new address search feature and[worldwide preloaded maps](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/893561/) .


Simply enter an address directly on the watch and receive guidance to your destination. It’s a simple addition, but one that can make a big difference when traveling somewhere new or navigating an unfamiliar area.


## Introducing MARQ Diver


MARQ (Gen 3) also introduces a new addition to the collection: MARQ Diver. Designed for those who spend time on or around the water, it combines a refined marine-inspired design with specialized boating and diving features.


Its arrival also marks an important milestone for the MARQ family. For the first time, every MARQ (Gen 3) model features leakproof buttons and is rated for dives up to 40 meters, bringing added protection and peace of mind wherever the day leads.


## Is it time to upgrade?


If you’ve enjoyed the craftsmanship and performance of MARQ (Gen 2), MARQ (Gen 3) delivers meaningful upgrades across the board.


Whether you’re upgrading for the added connectivity, improved navigation or enhanced everyday convenience, MARQ (Gen 3) is designed to help you get even more from your watch. Explore our newest additions to the[MARQ family](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/luxury-smartwatches/) and discover the luxury watch designed for your passion.


1Active plan required; LTE network coverage is not available in all regions. Satellite connection and SOS functionality on this device have important limitations compared to other inReach devices that could affect the performance of connected features, making them unavailable in certain situations. Check[Garmin.com/marqfeaturerequirements](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/marqfeaturerequirements/) for requirements and limitations and to see which services are accessible in your area — or in areas to where you may be traveling to ensure the performance, coverage, and service levels of this device are suitable for your intended use.
